messages:
Priya (Partnerships): hey team — new marketplace onboarding thread for AWS/GCP/Azure. goal: lightweight launch package (assets + IAM + SKU mapping) to get a staging offer up by next Thu. quick heads-up on blockers: legal T&Cs, telemetry language, and reserved-instance SKUs.

Tom (Legal): on it. i'll comb the publisher agreement and draft a short DPA addendum for EU/UK. flag me for any customer-data residency claims you want to surface.

Alejandra (Product): product proposal: single SKU family `redwood-inference` with plans `starter`, `standard`, `enterprise`. reserved GPU will be a separate `reserved` SKU with accompanying commit levels. trial = 14d token-limited sandbox. i'll attach a mapping sheet.

Mikhail (Cloud Ops): infra notes: need cross-account role for AWS Marketplace sandbox, a GCP service account with the right IAM bindings, and the Azure Offer ID. minimal AWS trust example: `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"marketplace.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}`.

Ben (DevRel): DevRel will build quickstart + terraform + demo script. request staging creds and a test tenant with sample data. can infra-bot create a ticket?

ticket-bot: created MKT-5012 for staging-tenant + creds. owner: Mikhail. ETA 48h.

Priya (Partnerships): visibility items: icon/hero art (1280x640), short description, detailed product summary, support contacts. also confirm whether we need localized descriptions for FR/DE/ES at launch.

Alejandra (Product): localization: prioritize EN + DE at launch. we'll provide localized short descriptions and EULAs for DE/EU.

Tom (Legal): telemetry question: what are we collecting? agree opt-in for trial tenants. please list metrics in doc so i can craft telemetry language for Azure/EU marketplace requirements.

Ben (DevRel): list: token counts, request latency buckets, error rates, anonymized prompt hashes (no raw text stored). default opt-out for telemetry during trial; opt-in prompt on first sign-in.

Mikhail (Cloud Ops): note about artifacts: we'll publish a container image `redwood/inference:marketplace-v1` and AMI image for AWS. need CI pipeline to tag images with marketplace suffix. I'll add pipeline ticket.

Priya (Partnerships): action items roundup:
- Tom (Legal): DPA + telemetry wording for marketplaces (due Wed COB)
- Alejandra (Product): final SKU mapping + localized short descriptions (due Tue)
- Mikhail (Cloud Ops): IAM snippets + images + staging creds (MKT-5012) (due Thu)
- Ben (DevRel): quickstart + terraform + demo flow (due next Mon)

Ben (DevRel): will include mock invoices and a switch to simulate trial->paid conversion. also adding a sample support flow.

Priya (Partnerships): i'll schedule a sync for Wed 11am PT to review artifacts and signoffs. dropping the assets link: https://intra.redwood/marketplace/onboard/artifacts — please comment on the doc. :sparkles:
